alt.en: A long gray conveyor belt carries two teal tokens, and a dashed orange arc with an arrow leaps from one token to the next. A dotted indigo line joins an indigo-tinted log card on the left to the belt's start, and a dotted gray line joins a gray camera on the right to its end.
alt.zh: 一条灰色长传送带上放着两枚青绿色圆块，一道带箭头的橙色虚线弧从前一枚跃向后一枚。左侧一块靛蓝色日志卡以靛蓝点线连到传送带起点，右侧一台灰色相机以灰色点线连到终点。

caption.en: Illustration: an agent's state moves along a long execution line from one transfer to the next, with an audit point recording the handoffs at one end and a camera standing in for an auditor at the other. It does not depict the authors' middleware or a tested deployment, and it does not show that the records catch every failure.
caption.zh: 示意图：智能体的状态沿一条长执行线从一次转移传到下一次，一端的审计点记录每次交接，另一端的相机代表审计者。图中并非作者的中间件或经过测试的部署，也不表示这些记录能捕获所有故障。
